drafts.subject: Re: Exploring Collaboration Opportunities
drafts.message:
Hi Tyler,

Thank you for reaching out and for your kind words about our walker abstraction. We appreciate your interest in GrowthMetrics and the value your service offers in converting GitHub stars into active users. A 15-minute call sounds like a great idea to explore potential collaboration. Please let me know your availability next week, and we can schedule a time that works.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

drafts.subject: Re: Invitation to Speak at AgentConf 2026
drafts.message:
Dear Elena,

Thank you very much for the kind invitation to speak at AgentConf 2026 in Berlin. We are honored by the opportunity to present on Jac and the walker model. I will confirm participation and provide the speaker details by August 15 as requested.

We appreciate the offer to cover travel and accommodation and look forward to further details.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
